Name: Little Red School House
Author: xiddav
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Adds an old broken school house to pelican town near the playground. [/b][/size][/center][size=3]Penny, Jas, and Vincent will go to school here once it is fixed. 

has schedules for modded children[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7940]
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp (Eloise)
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]RSV[/url][/size]

Lazy version school is fully functional from the start. Nothing to repair.



[size=3]The chance to fix the school will come with the [/size][size=4][u]special orders board[/u][/size]
[size=3]The [s]Woodpile[/s] Tool Box inside the ruined school is where you take the items.
[/size]
Starting year 2 if you enter the ruined school on the first day of a season you will get a short event. After the event the quest Higher Education will be in your journal. You have that season to fix the school. If you fail to fix the school by the end of the season, you will have to wait for the quest to appear on the special order board.

[spoiler]
If you don't want to wait for it to randomly appear on the board, in the smapi window enter
[i][code]debug specialorder Lewis9695
[/code][/i] that will give you the mission.


It takes wood, hardwood, cloth, and gold bars.
In the ruined school house there is a [color=#ffe599][s]woodpile [/s]Tool Box [/color]you can put the stuff in.
Robin will send you a [b]Letter [/b]the next day letting you know she got the stuff and will start working on repairs.
[b]After 3pm[/b], enter the farm. Robin will come tell you she is done with repairs.
The next non festival day, go to town 6:10am-2:50pm to see the school opening.
The school schedule changes will start the next day.[/spoiler]
[size=1]

[/size][size=5]Config options[/size]
[size=3][i][b]Five Days [/b] [/i]This makes most students go to school on Monday and Thursday
[i]Seat # Antisocial   [/i]if true the available antisocial kids will start going to school is you have been to the railroad. They come from the train station.[/size]

[size=3][i][b]Playground Expansion[/b][/i]
basketball
sandbox
custom
none[/size]

NOTE:
[quote]Using Generic Mod Config Menu to change the playground while in game will cause NPCs to walk into the void if they are in town.[/quote]




[b]School Schedule[/b]
[spoiler]
Museum (this is unchanged vanilla)
Every Wednesday & Friday
Every other Tuesday (not the 9th nor 23rd)
except when it's raining

Little Red Schoolhouse
all students in their seats by 10:00 am
Every Wednesday & Friday
Every other Tuesday (not the 9th nor 23rd)
Even when it is raining, but not Thunderstorms nor Green Rain
+
Monday and Thursday (not raining) when [i]Five Days[/i] config is true.
3rd day of the desert festival the students go on a field trip.
[/spoiler]
